notes.title: Walls and Towers Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/a8780e6e3d4f04c15532480e06194ab5689950bd.png[/img]

[b]Changelog v1.2.0[/b]

TL;DR
- New walls and towers
- New background visuals
- New resources and items
- New Towers upgrades
- Quickslot inventory
- More save slots
- Pause game
- Artifacts
- Automatic crafting

[h2]New Walls and Towers[/h2]

[list]
[*] buildings cannot be built outside the most far away walls.
[*] there are two more walls.
[*] walls and towers block enemies no matter where they are built.
[*] enemies break through walls and towers. They are not entirely destroyed anymore. Workers can rebuild them later.
[*] you can now garrison archers on walls level 2+
[*] walls can hold one item.
[*] with every wall upgrade, walls behind settlement change appearance as well.
[*] two more wall and tower levels
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/07dbf6dde2fbe19e549d0c34bde21b327562192d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/15b70cd19baec1b189b63c9fbd288615aca0bd0c.png[/img]

[h2]New resources and items[/h2]
[list]
[*] 14 new resources used for various recipes and upgrades.
[*] enemies now have a chance of dropping resources.
[*] abyss shard can only be dropped by cemetery, deep forest monsters, last wave monster and wandering traders.
[*] 4 new amber lanterns that give special effects to buildings with archers.
[*] 3 new potions.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/e7140b80af69450019dfc002da55ee5d430037e1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/031d89dfe013a7dd0549d3dacaa80054bec35623.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/bffc55e77b7942a41a0de7c2a523f9d4084048c4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/b58988298742cdf0a8796765b60576814fde0f36.png[/img]

[h2]Quick Slot inventory[/h2]
[list]
[*] you can now carry 3 more items in your inventory
[*] items in inventory do not have an effect
[*] items in inventory do not stack
[*] items in inventory do not drop on death
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/40d3e40a9cc50e80f5ae6f7d624f67b3b430ad27.png[/img]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] 2 more save slots
[*] opening menu pauses the game 😀
[*] automatic crafting items option
[*] 3 new hero weapon upgrades
[*] first artifact item craftable by blacksmith
[/list]

I have no special plans for next update but there is a [b][url=https://discord.com/channels/1069711701412417578/1115541873533145088]vote for feature poll on discord[/url][/b]. I invite you all to vote! 

Thank you All for all the ideas and hope you like this update :)

notes.title: Cook and blacksmith update!
notes.notes:
In [b]v1.1.0[/b] there are some changes, lets begin from the top:

[b]TL;DR[/b]
- 3 Starting packages, you can choose 1
- Easy difficulty level
- Skip tutorial option
- Day and hour info in UI
- Efficiency stat
- Attack speed stat
- New job - Cook
- New job - Blacksmith
- House now make money out of fame
- Roadhouse now hires cooks that make special food
- Cannot buy lanterns and torches in main tower
- Lanterns and torches craftable by Blacksmith
- Coal as craftable item
- New special food with buffs
- pick up stone/ore task instead of pick up stone
- message on top that game was autosaved
- pots harvests instantly
- farmers harvests faster
- Roadhouse increase population stat decreased by 2
- Special traders from different settlements spawning once a day.
- Artifacts/Materials in next update

You can now [b]choose a starting package[/b] that will help you run your settlement at the beginning 
- Farmer packages gives you 3 carrots, 3 cabbages and 4 turnips
- Noble package gives you 6 gold coins
- Builder package gives you 5 wood and 5 stone

There is a [b]new difficulty level[/b]:
- Easy is a more peaceful mode with monsters spawning less often so you can chill and build your settlement with ease. Easy mode still allows you to spawn monsters earlier.

There is a new option to [b]skip the starting tutorial[/b]. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/6cf381c4e81634fb1e3a4e622c51d689a02fad6c.png[/img]

There is a date icon in the ui which tells you what day and hour it is;
Players start with a few torches spread on the map because you can no longer buy them in the main tower. But more on that in a moment 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/8784dbbfb7ad001b7539b79b805d81797b94fe9b.png[/img]

[b]There are two new stats[/b]:
- Efficiency for your workers. Example: Worker needs 10 swings of axe to get a wood log from a tree. With +5 efficiency buff it will take 7 swings.

- Attack speed for your soldiers and archers and also your workers. Your soldiers and archers hit faster. Workers with attack speed work faster as well.

[b]Changes in buildings[/b]
- You can no longer buy items like torches and lanterns in the main tower. Lanterns are now craftable in a blacksmith building.
- Blacksmith buildings can now hire blacksmiths that can craft some items and resources.
- You can no longer buy workers in house. House now can convert fame into money. Just like Roadhouse before.
- Roadhouses on the other hand can no longer do that. Now Roadhouse can hire cooks that can craft special food that gives buffs to your workers and soldiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/37f4ab862251beb501a740042d223b6a0e2696a6.png[/img]

[b]Small adjustments[/b]
- The miner's task “pick up stone” is now changed to “pick up stone/ore” so he can pick up clay, coal iron and gold.
- vegetables in pots now harvests instantly automatically, as it was annoying to keep slashing it
- farmers harvest vegetables faster
- message on top that game was autosaved
- Roadhouse increase population stat decreased by 2
- Special traders from different settlements spawning once a day instead of 3 daily.

No artifacts/materials yet
I could add a new item group, but they will have no use yet, so I decided to add them in the next update.

notes.title: Iron and clay update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I had this idea in my mind when i started making this game, that player would not have easy access to all resources to force trading a little more, but it was not clear enough :D

Some of you did not know how to go further so in version 1.0.6 i added both clay and iron resources that can be mineable by workers. 

These resources are limited like stones, can be healed and can still be traded. Coal and gold might be added in next version.

Thanks all and have fun :)

notes.title: Management Update!
notes.notes:
Hello all! 

I wanted to share a new feature that is available now with new version 1.0.3.

[h2]Task Priorities Management[/h2]

I've spent many hours on thinking which tasks, workers should do first and i was never fully satisfied with the results. So now[b] players can set priorities of tasks by themselves[/b]. You can even order that eating or sleeping is not so important. Your workers will not like it but, its your choice :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/d14dbe40070fae105387542a3e4620ed9dfc0723.png[/img]

[h2]Food Management[/h2]

In previous versions, workers could eat whatever was available. Now you can set what can or cannot be eaten. This feature will make it easier to gather more of some special ingredients needed for crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/c1efc22fda906a4a2ecf675903a84073e5e4bc77.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43094257/f8b723da6d50dd1ad15a3689fb5262622b2389e4.png[/img]

Thank you all, and have fun in Amber Trail :)

notes.title: Release update. v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Big things that happend this update:

Soldiers now gets hungry and workers have new job which is feeding hungry soldiers. Workers and soldiers that doesnt get food on time are hungry and do things slower and lose health over time.

Items like stones, berries (resources) can now disappear if away and not picked up for a while. Torches, pots and other items like this will not disappear.

Cemetery looks different now, more like a cemetery :D

Also:

Some tips now will appear at the beginning, guiding players a little more.

I've added autosave, just in case. Balanced game a little more, added new monster and fixed some bugs. Added some missing tooltips and items descriptions.

Updated building package process that improved overall performance of the game.



[b]Game will be released on time, which is this sunday :) 12 Feb 2023[/b]

notes.title: Release update
notes.notes:
Hello all!

I know i have not posted for a while but wanted to focus on polishing the game so I had to drop social for a while. But now I am back and cannot wait to tell you all new features and changes I made to make game better. I will try to post more often and try to bring more attention to the game.



Testing

One minor bug fixed. Made a lot of tweeks to the game to make it more balanced. Early game do not feel overwhelming and late game is not that easy as some suggested.



Release

Demo with fixed fighting and trades is still not ready and I apologize, but i hope to release it this weekend. I also wanted to prepare version of the game for linux and i hope to make it work. Not sure if it is going to be available this weekend aswell.

In the next full version 0.1.7 there will be bug fix, new monster, feature to haggle trades, balanced trading offers, there will also be a attitude of other cities towards you, and info from your workers, soldiers and other villages about what they think of you or their current situation. And last feature which is not done yet: Special quests from other villages. And that is all the new features i want to make before the final release.



Thank you all for being patient!

notes.title: Release update
notes.notes:
Release update

After releasing the Demo i gathered some very good feedback, thanks for playing and commenting on the game. This helps me a lot.

The main issues was with fighting. For a lot of players, fighting was hard and felt not entirely fair. Which is why in next update range of attack and hitboxes are bigger. Now it is easier to hit enemy and fighting is way better.

Next issue was with Roadhouse, it was too complicated for the players to buy tinctures and make fair enough of money, now it is simpler. Roadhouse converts fame to gold overtime. You can turn it on and off depends on whether you want to spend fame or not. No longer tinctures are required.

Trading feels like some resources like clay or iron are almost impossible to get. Also at the beginning there are offers where player has to trade something that is not availiable at the beginning. Now generating trade offers is based on playtime to assure that player will have types of resources for the trade and resources like iron or clay are way easier to get but for a bigger price. Also there will be a feature that will allow you to roll trades again in exchange for fame. This will allow players to get better trade offers and advance in game easier.

Thank you all again and have fun at Amber Trail :)

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
I know i planned to release the game 11.11.2022. But I will not have enough wishlists for that date. 

Also as there is definitely less bugs, there are still some and I want to make sure that it will not affect the gameplay.

Another reason is that the avarage gameplay is 3 hours and I want to add more content so it will be much more than that. I decided to release the game on  February 13 on Steam, as it is good strategic date given steam fest is starting that day.

I Realize that it is long time before my initial planned date and current planned date which is why I am gonna release a Demo of the game. You can have a little fun with the game sooner than initial release date, and I can gather more feedback of what the players want.

Demo is already sent to Steam for approval And I hope that it will be released this week. Friday maybe.

Humble apologies that I have to delay the release.
